subject: GOBACK statement
notes: A phrase-free GOBACK emits NO status write at all, so Environment.ExitCode keeps its 0 default and the run unit terminates normally - the theory's 'GOBACK.' -> 0 row is the GOBACK-arm pin, and the zero-scaffolding invariant (DESIGN 18.16) is what makes the default rather than an explicit write carry it. The rule's escape clause ('unless error termination has been indicated by an implementor-defined mechanism') has exactly one such mechanism in this implementation and it is documented: ProgramTable.AbnormalTermination writes the 14.6.12 diagnostic to stderr and sets exit code 1 for a fatal condition that reaches the run-unit boundary - which by construction cannot coexist with a completed GOBACK in the same run, so no ordering conflict exists. Applies at every edition GOBACK exists in (2002+), unlike GR7/GR8 whose phrases are 2023 introductions.  || CODE SITES (verbatim from the adjudication, kept because the schema's code-location is symbol-keyed, not line-keyed): src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/Verbs/CallEmitter.cs#EmitGoback (no SetExitStatus is emitted when g.Status is null); src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Control/ProgramTable.cs#AbnormalTermination
